svg.title: AI Collaboration Summary — All time
svg.desc: 375 AI-attributed commits, 463 AI actor presences across 58 active AI days (author dates), 7 AI providers. Daily activity calendar 2026-04-22 to 2026-07-14, peak day 10 attributed commits. Generated 2026-07-14.
